processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Alloy ingots with nominal composition Fe-35Mn-15Al-5Cu (at.%) produced by melting high-purity (>99.9%) raw materials using a vacuum induction furnace under an argon atmosphere; alloy referred to as 15Al.
Hot-rolled into plates with a thickness of 4 mm.
processing_steps.reduction_ratio: rolled into plates with a thickness of 4 mm

processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Plates cut into 10 × 5 × 2 mm³ samples using electrical discharge machining for Vickers hardness measurements and microstructure characterizations.
Solution treated at 1100 °C for 10 min under an argon atmosphere, followed by oil quenching (this is the parent process proc_st-1100c-10min-oq).
The solution-treated sample was aged at 550 °C for 6 h, followed by water quenching (process proc_aging-550c-6h).

interfaces.interface_notes: In the peak-hardness Fe-Mn-Al-Cu alloys, new BCC phase and FCC Cu-rich phase formed at the interfaces between the β-Mn (b0068). TEM of the 15Al alloy aged at 600 °C for 6 h showed fine FCC Cu-rich particles (with FCC twins) at the β-Mn interfaces (b0057/figure_011); for the 550 °C/6 h condition only the new BCC phase is explicitly resolved in the EBSD phase map (figure_004).
interfaces.phase_evolution: The microstructure evolution during aging of the Fe-Mn-Al-Cu low-density steels followed the sequence α → α + FCC Cu-rich phase → α-Mn + β-Mn + BCC phase → β-Mn + BCC phase + FCC Cu-rich phase. For the 15Al alloy aged at 550 °C for 6 h, the α matrix had almost entirely transformed into β-Mn with a new fine BCC phase within the β-Mn.

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: coarse grains (IPF map b1 of figure_004 shows coarse elongated grains for the 550 °C/6 h condition)

phases_present.morphology: near-equiaxed matrix (uniformly green β-Mn in the EBSD phase map)
phases_present.volume_fraction: α matrix had almost entirely transformed into β-Mn (near-complete β-Mn)

phases_present.morphology: fine phase present within the β-Mn; elongated red network in the phase map

precipitates.distribution: within the β-Mn (at/growing from the β-Mn interfaces)

structures.overall_structure: After aging at 550 °C for 6 h, the α matrix of the 15Al alloy had almost entirely transformed into β-Mn, and a new fine BCC phase was present within the β-Mn.

measurement_conditions.other_conditions: Vickers hardness measured with an HVS-1000 digital microhardness tester at a load of 9.8 N for 15 s; each sample repeatedly tested 5 times and the hardness given by the average of 5 measurements.
